_readme: The ScriptGrain Writing Index, definition v1.0, frozen 2026-10-11 before any full measurement of the 2026-Q4 point. Changing a measure, a statistic or a threshold is a new major version and goes in the changelog; a refresh that only adds a period keeps the version's major number.
name: The ScriptGrain Writing Index

collection_window.note: Fetched once per site; see the pre-registration for the date actually used.

headline_measures.label: Words of prose on the homepage
AI-era vocabulary, style words only, per 1,000 words
Share of homepages with at least one em dash
headline_measures.change_statistic: difference in the share, matched sites

summary: First release of the Index. Starts from the 2,950 measured homepage-years of SGR-004 (161 companies, 2000 to 2026, Wayback captures nearest 1 July) and adds one live fetch of each company's current homepage as period 2026-Q4.
Fixes the six headline measures, their statistics and the thresholds for calling a quarter-on-quarter move a change. No composite score.
Columns are those of the SGR-004 dataset plus index_version, period, collected, source and ai_era_style_per1000 (SGR-004 derived it in its analysis step; the Index stores it).

columns_note: Column names never change within a major version. A new column is added at the end and noted in the changelog; a column is never renamed or repurposed.
